name: 🗡️ Steal Time Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Steal Time Simulator 👋 (A Steal Time From Others Game)

🔥 | Gain Time by staying outside the safezone to purchase new crates and new swords! 
🌟 | Rebirth to gain advantages over others!
🗡️ | Over 30+ different swords, each including a special kill effect. Enjoy sword fighting! 
👍 | For more updates, like the game and join the group! 
⚔️ | Kill others to steal other's time! 
🏆 | Become #1!

• The time you can gain per kill is based on your level
• Time gain is enabled in private servers

🌟 | LIKE AND FAVORITE THE GAME FOR MORE UPDATES & EVENTS!
💬 | Join the group for an additional +1 time gain! ❤️

💬 | Community Invite: sittingsimulator (13+) 

❗ Exploiting of any kind is NOT allowed and WILL result in a ban.
